comparison.objective: Set and clamp a jigsaw shoe at a 45-degree bevel; candidate selectively separates media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Lever release, constrained slide, angular adjustment and clamping versus bimanual lifting, sifting through apertures and reseating.
comparison.success_condition: 45±2° bevel, clamp verification and released stillness versus ≥98% media recovery, complete washer retention, supported screen and 3-second release dwell.
comparison.reason: The record tests adjustment and locking of an articulated tool component, not selective many-body separation; no material rubric detail needed for this distinction is missing.
